name: City Council - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 13, 2015 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation declaring May as Bike Month and May 15, 2015 as Bike to Work Day in the City of Encinitas.
4B.
Presentation of Senior of the Year Awards.
4C.
Proclamation declaring May 17-23, 2015 as Public Works Week.
4D.
Presentation of Leichtag Foundation check toward the purchase and installation of Vehicle Speed Feedback Signs on Quail Gardens Drive.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 4/15/15 Regular Meeting, 4/22/15 Special Joint Meeting, 4/22/15 Regular Meeting and the 4/29/15 Special Joint Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-05-13 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2015-05-13 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance 2015-07, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 20.08 - Stormwater Management & Discharge Control Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-07, titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 20.08 - Stormwater Management & Discharge Control Ordinance."
2015-05-13 Item 8C - Stormwater Ordinance 2015-07 Amendments
8D.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance 2015-06, amending the City Building Code to promote solar-photovoltaic and electric vehicle charging systems. Contact Person: Planning Director Murphy
Adopt City Council Ordinance 2015-06, entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending sections 23.12.030 and 23.12.035 related to solar energy and electric vehicle ready buildings."
2015-05-13 Item 8D- Green Codes
8E.
Introduction of City Council Ordinance 2015-09, amending the Encinitas Municipal Code to increase the fine from $500 to $1,000. This fine applies in cases where a violation continues to occur following the issuance of the third and subsequent administrative citation. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
Introduce City Council Ordinance 2015-06 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, amending section 1.08.050 related to increasing enforcement fines from $500 to $1,000."
2015-05-13 Item 8E - Administrative Fines Ordinance
8F.
Adoption of Ordinance 2015-03 Setting Cardiff Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates and Ordinance 2015-04 Setting Encinitas Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-03, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Of Encinitas City Council Setting Cardiff Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates" and Ordinance No. 2015-04, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Of Encinitas City Council Setting Encinitas Sanitary Division Sewer Service Rates."
2015-05-13 Item 8F - Adoption of Ordinances 2015-03 and 2015-04
8G.
Adoption of Resolution 2015-14 approving the FY2015-20 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing Choice. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-14 approving the proposed FY2015-20 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing Choice (AI) and, 2) Authorize the City Manager to transmit the FY2015-20 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments and required certifications to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development.
2015-05-13 Item 8G - FY2015-20 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing Choice
8H.
Summary vacation of an unused portion of road right-of-way located at 1244 Summit Avenue. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-12 approving the summary vacation of a portion of Summit Avenue right-of-way fronting the property at 1244 Summit Avenue.
2015-05-13 Item 8H - Summary Vacation at Summit Avenue
8I.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters for the Mayor's signature.
2015-05-13 Item 8I - Legislative Position Letters
8J.
Leichtag Foundation donation for vehicle speed feedback signs on Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive. Contact Person: Deputy Public Works Director Deane
Accept the donation of $20,000 from the Leichtag Foundation.
2015-05-13 Item 8J - Leichtag Foundation Donation for Vehicle Speed Signs
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Council to meet with applicants for the two tenant commissioner positions on the Housing Authority. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving as a tenant commissioner to the Housing Authority and Council discussion as needed.
2015-05-13 Item 10A - Housing Commission Interviews
10B.
Council discussion and direction regarding Intrepid Theater Company's proposal to build a performing arts theater on the theater pad (Lot 16) at the Encinitas Ranch Town Center. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Direct staff to enter in to lease negotiations with Intrepid Theatre Company to build a performing arts theater on Lot 16 at the Encinitas Ranch Town Center and pending successful negotiations, bring back proposed lease agreement for Council consideration within 90 days.
2015-05-13 Item 10B - Intrepid Theater Pad Proposal
10C.
Fiscal Year 2014/15 Third Quarter Budget Review. Contact Person: Finance Manager Shoemaker
Adopt City Council Resolution 2015-25, approving the Third Quarter Budget Adjustments for FY2014/15.
2015-05-13 Item 10C - 3rd Quarter Budget Update
10D.
Introduction of Proposed FY15-16 and FY16-17 Operating Budget. Contact Person: Finance Manager Shoemaker
1) Review proposed FY15-16 and FY16-17 operating budget; 2) Receive public input; 3) Identify revisions to the proposed FY15-16 and FY16-17 operating budget; and 4) Provide direction to staff regarding funding for decision package proposals.
2015-05-13 Item 10D - FY2016 and FY2017 Draft Operating Budget (Pages 10,11,18,20 Updated)
2015-05-13 Item 10D - Attachment 8 - DRAFT Budget (Part 1)
2015-05-13 Item 10D - Attachment 8 - DRAFT Budget (Part 2)
10E.
Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low-Impact Development (LID) Retrofit Plan. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Receive staff's presentation and approve the Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low-Impact Development (LID) Retrofit Plan; and 2) Authorize the Director of Public Works to apply for future stormwater grant funding as it becomes available in order to implement the projects identified in the plan.
2015-05-13 Item 10E - Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low Impact Development Retrofit Plan (Part 1)
2015-05-13 Item 10E - Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low Impact Development Retrofit Plan (Part 2)
2015-05-13 Item 10E - Cottonwood Creek Watershed Low Impact Development Retrofit Plan (Part 3)
10F.
Caltrans Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant to develop the Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Accept the Caltrans Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant in order to develop the Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan; 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-24; 3) Authorize appropriation of grant funding in the amount of $175,000 to the Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan project, Project No. WC15A; and 4) Provide staff direction related to information to be contained in a Request for Proposal for consultant services.
2015-05-13 Item 10F - Encinitas Rail Corridor Vision Plan
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
An informational report on the State regulations pertaining to drug/alcohol treatment homes in residential areas and the status of the lawsuit filed related to the City of Newport Beach's and City of Costa Mesa's "Sober Living Ordinance." Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
Receive the report.
2015-05-13 Item 11A - Sober Living Informational Report
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-05-13 Item 15 - City Manager's Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
